About Austrian Airlines AG

Discover a world full of possibilities. Make your professional dreams come true at Austrian Airlines. We are an open and warmhearted community where internationality and open-mindedness play a major role. Hospitality and service-orientation are our top priorities, we put people - our employees just like our guests first. We are focusing on creating an inspiring working environment where everyone can feel at home. Together we can create unforgettable experiences and memories. Let us #CreateJourneysTogether

We are looking for 2 Senior Technical Purchasers (all genders)  We've got the aircraft, you've got the drive and passion for technology! 

Tasks

 * You are responsible for sourcing spare parts for the repair of aircraft components, including selecting suitable sourcing channels, order tracking, and tracking parts throughout the repair cycle.

 * You provide operational support and expertise to Strategic Procurement in negotiating contracts and are responsible for their operational execution.

 * You manage projects to expand the 3rd party customer portfolio and the capability of the workshops.

 * Together with internal customers and suppliers, you develop solutions to ensure a reliable supply of materials to ensure the timely repair of aircraft parts.

 * You implement measures to prevent material shortages.

 * You analyze demand, inventory levels, supplier performance, and procurement costs, and derive appropriate measures for optimization.

 * You are be responsible for maintaining relevant data in AMOS. 

 

Ready to take off with us?

At Austrian Airlines, the only things that count are your skills, your motivation and what makes you special as a person. Origin, gender or age are irrelevant: together we bring people and cultures together and give our work real meaning. Convinced? Then apply now! 

Requirements

 * You have a solid technical or commercial background (e.g. HTL, HAK or a comparable qualification) or possess relevant practical experience.

 * You have relevant professional experience in procurement, supply chain mgmt, or logistics, and ideally, you are already familiar with similar processes. 

 * You are proficient in standard MS Office applications - practical experience with AMOS is a major advantage for us.

 * You communicate fluently in both German and English (negotiation level).

 * You possess sound knowledge of current aviation regulations that play a role in our daily operations.

 * You impress with your confident demeanor, remain focused even during stressful periods, and value working as part of a team.

 * You have unrestricted access to the Austrian labor market.

* Your actual salary resp.remuneration will be determined individually based on your qualifications and professional experience. Depending on your experience and expertise, a higher salary may be offered. If not all requirements of the position are met, the position and individual grading may be reassessed.

As Ground Safety Expert you`ll own risk management and assurance processes across ground safety, including dangerous goods. You will investigate occurrences, support Safety Risk Evaluations, maintain our Ground Operations hazards register and work closely with Ground Operations, Austro Control and DHL group airlines to keep our ground and cargo operations safe. Reporting to the Senior Supervisor Safety, you will play a visible, hands-on role in a Just Culture safety environment where your analysis and recommendations directly inform how we manage risks.

Your Tasks:
 * Coordinate, investigate and manage ground safety investigations and occurrence reports, assessing risk, identifying root causes and recommending corrective and preventative actions.
 * Prepare, coordinate and facilitate the Ground Safety Action Group and contribute to the Safety Review Board.
 * Maintain and develop the Ground Operations hazard register in close partnership with Ground Operations.
 * Support risk assessments of occurrence reports and contribute to Safety Risk Evaluations on ground safety topics.
 * Own the administration and control of ground safety related reports, SPIs and statistics - spotting trends and following them up with the right people.

 * Be accountable for the quality, integrity and regulatory compliance of the risk data and recommendations you produce, in line with IOSA ISARPs and DHA standards.

Your Qualifications:
 * An undergraduate degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 * 5 years of relevant work experience, including at least 2 years in the aeronautical industry.
 * A dangerous goods training certificate - CAT 10 or similar competency-based DG training preferred.
 * Solid experience with risk management and assurance processes in aviation and familiarity with management systems.
 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.
 * Fluent in English, strong MS Office skills and the interpersonal skills to build effective relationships across the business.
 * The ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and stay composed under pressure.

We Offer:
 * Exciting career opportunities in a dynamic, international aviation environment
 * A modern, newly designed office located directly at Vienna Airport with excellent public transport connections
 * Attractive employee benefits, including airport shopping discounts, access to myID travel, corporate benefits, supported KlimaTicket or parking options, Edenred vouchers, and much more.
 * For this roles, we offer a competitive minimum gross salary of € 4,623 based on full-time employment with the possibility of an adjusted salary depending on your experience and qualification. 
 * In addition, we offer an attractive company bonus scheme.
 * This position is initially offered on a two-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent position thereafter.

 * Contribute to the development of new products and technologies within our Industrial Digitalization portfolio.

 

Technical Expert Activities

What do I need to qualify for this job?

 * Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts and practical experience with C++.
 * Practical experience with prototyping, automation, data processing, or related technical applications.
 * Strong interest in combining software development with industrial applications and sensor technologies.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Ability and willingness to explain complex technical concepts to customers, operators, and internal stakeholders through documentation, training, and technical discussions.
 * Fluent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

 

Nice to have

 * Experience with sensor technologies  with 2D and/or 3D image processing  in industrial automation environments.
 * Knowledge of signal processing.
 * Pracical experience in working directly with customers in technical project, commissioning, or support environments.
